Remark
[arbitrary initial values and derivative notation] ↗ prop:dc-ch5-2-4 1. ch5:2.6The construction of equation 3 extends to Jacobi fields with arbitrary initial value. We henceforth write $\frac{DJ}{dt}=J'$ and $\frac{D^2 J}{dt^2}=J''$, etc.
